entries.title: Elemental application and internal cooldowns
entries.summary: An elemental hit can deal elemental damage without applying an element or triggering a reaction on that hit. Internal cooldown behavior depends on the elemental source.
entries.content: Elemental damage and elemental application are separate outcomes. Internal cooldown (ICD) can limit how often a source applies an element, triggers a reaction, or produces certain damage and poise events. A commonly described pattern uses both a hit count and a timer, but ability-specific sequences can differ, separate abilities can share ICD, and some sources have no ICD. Treat standard ICD shorthand as a general explanation only; use attack-specific evidence for calculations.
limitations: This is a general concept entry, not an attack-by-attack dataset.
The cited reference describes a simplified, commonly accepted overview and notes that source behavior varies.
GenshinDex has not independently tested the current game version; do not use this entry as an authoritative simulation parameter.
